source.name: All India Pincode Directory till last month
source.publisher: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India

inclusion_rule: Include a PIN when at least one published post-office row belongs to Delhi state or to Gurgaon/Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, or Gautam Buddha Nagar district.
dedupe_rule: One row per six-digit PIN. Components, districts, and states are sorted semicolon-delimited sets; office_count counts distinct office names.
exclusion_rule: At deduplicated PIN level, exclude only a PIN with zero approved-component office rows when it shares a three-digit postal prefix with an included PIN. A PIN with any approved-component office is included exactly once and excluded nowhere. This is a near-scope audit universe, not an exhaustive all-India rejection list.
warning: PIN codes are postal service areas, not boundary polygons. District membership is office-based and must not be used as point-in-polygon proof.
